newsitem.title: USA: Nissan's Infiniti cuts price of new J30.
newsitem.headline: Nissan's Infiniti cuts price of new J30.

text.p: Infiniti said on Monday it has set the manufacturer's suggested retail price of its new 1997.5 model year J30 luxury sedan at $33,995, down $2,250 from the previous version.
Infiniti is the luxury division of Nissan Motor Corp U.S.A, a unit of Nissan Motor Co Ltd.
The company said the price drop is in keeping with its "consumer-based pricing" philosophy. The price includes delivery charges of $495.

"Last June we lowered the MSRP on a number of our Infiniti luxury vehicles in order to bring them in closer alignment with what consumers are likely to pay," Tom Eastwood, vice president of the division, said in a statement.
Changes in the new J30 include an improved audio system and a new pewter exterior color, which replaces the previous beige and pebble, Infiniti said.
